Package org.opencastproject.lifecyclemanagement.impl

Class LifeCyclePolicyImpl

java.lang.Object
org.opencastproject.lifecyclemanagement.impl.LifeCyclePolicyImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.opencastproject.lifecyclemanagement.api.LifeCyclePolicy
@Entity(name="LifeCyclePolicy") public class LifeCyclePolicyImpl extends Object implements org.opencastproject.lifecyclemanagement.api.LifeCyclePolicy
Entity object for storing life cycle policies in persistence storage. Policies define actions that should be applied to entities. They offer various methods of defining when an action should be applied, effectively allowing for scheduling of actions. The policy ACL only pertains to itself. The entities they may affect (e.g. events, series) are still only governed by their own ACLs.
